title: Affine open supported model torsion
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with derived categories of module sheaves and its localized open sites [def-pc-derived-category], and $f$ a compatible global scalar [def-sc-derived-global-scalar]. Let $Eprime$ have quasi-coherent cohomology whose stalks vanish outside $V(f)$. Fix an affine open $U$, an integer $k$, and a derived category of $A=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_X)$-modules. Let $F:D(A)\to D(\mathcal O_X\text{ over }U)$ have a natural isomorphism $F\circ Q\cong Q\circ\operatorname{affinePerfectSheafification}_*$ on complexes [lem-pc-affine-perfect-module-model]. For every given $M\in D(A)$ with $F(M)\cong R(Eprime[k])$, where $R$ is derived over-site restriction, every integer $i$ and $m\in H^i(M)$ admit $n\in\mathbf N$ such that $(f|_U)^n m=0$. This asserts a property of a given model, not existence of a model or a uniform exponent.

source.place: Tag 08EJ, affine support paragraph; Tag 06Z0 exact associated sheaf

proof.text: The affine sheafification is exact: tilde preserves finite limits and is a left adjoint, and the chart and over-site functors are equivalences. Descend the comparison hF by Localization.liftNatIso and use mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso to identify affine sheafification of H^i(M) with the restricted shifted cohomology.
Apply the ordinary module support comparison to this identification. Its support is disjoint from the basic open.
LocalizedModule.subsingleton_iff_disjoint and LocalizedModule.subsingleton_iff yield an annihilator in the powers submonoid for each element. Extract its exponent.

proof_origin.note: Exact affine sheafification directly identifies homology, without choosing a derived equivalence.

theorem affine_open_supported_model_torsion
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (f : RingCat.sectionsSubring (X.sheaf.obj ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat.{u}))
    (E' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (hSupport : ∀ (i : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ X.zeroLocus (U := ⊤) {f.val (op ⊤)} →
      Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E'.obj).val.presheaf x)))
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (k : ℤ)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ModuleCat.{u} (X.sheaf.obj.obj (op U)))]
    (F : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} (X.sheaf.obj.obj (op U))) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)))
    (hF : Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ F ≅
      (affinePerfectSheafification X U hU).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Q))
    (M : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} (X.sheaf.obj.obj (op U))))
    (hM : Nonempty (F.obj M ≅
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (E'.obj⟦k⟧))) :
    ∀ (i : ℤ) (m : (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (ModuleCat.{u} (X.sheaf.obj.obj (op U))) i).obj M),
      ∃ n : ℕ, (f.val (op U)) ^ n • m = 0
